title: This open-source CapCut clone is actually insane
description:
OpenCut is a free, open-source video editor with over 73,000 stars on GitHub, a real CapCut alternative. Timeline editing, trim, text, captions, effects, and no-watermark export. It connects to other apps too, so you can plug in tools like Higgsfield and pipe AI-generated content onto your timeline, with an API, third-party plugins, a desktop app, MCP servers, headless mode and automatic batch rendering. Free and open at opencut.app.

Get the full OpenCut guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/16LkWXfLgQZjzwGNaRCYwI3Wb4loi7ejY_bhkjNZ-gns/edit?usp=sharing
